// A steady wind with gusts. Speed is the mean wind speed along Direction;
// Turbulence is the dimensionless gust strength as a proportion of Speed in
// [0, 1]; GustFrequency is how often gust cycles occur.
type WindModel
    implements IValue
{
    Direction: Direction3D;
    Speed: Speed;
    Turbulence: Number;
    GustFrequency: Frequency;
}
